encoding.buildable: one character per tile: . clear land, buildable as is; t trees, cleared first; w water; x built on (track, road, house, industry, station, object, void)
encoding.gradients: one hex digit per tile: the largest height step to a neighbour (x+-1, y+-1), capped at f
encoding.ground: one character per tile: clear land g grass, b bare, r rough, k rocks, f fields, s snow, d desert; trees on G grass, R rough, D snow or desert, C shore; water w sea, n canal, v river, c coast; - built on (the tile types in openttd://map say what)
encoding.row_digests: one 16-hex-digit FNV-1a per row over its tile types, heights, slopes, ground and vehicles: re-read only the rows whose digest changed
encoding.slopes: one string per row (y), two hex digits per tile (x): the tile's Slope bits (corners W=1 S=2 E=4 N=8, steep=0x10; 00 flat)
encoding.vehicles: one character per tile: . none, 1-9 the number of vehicle parts standing there, + more
